summary: Hong Kong 97 is an infamous unlicensed Super Famicom doujin shooter, with preservation tied to original disk/cartridge provenance and careful content documentation.

entries.title: Hong Kong 97
entries.definitive_edition: Original Super Famicom release or documented preservation dump with hash/provenance

emulation.emulator: bsnes / Mesen-S only with documented dump
emulation.notes: Use hardware if a provenanced copy exists; otherwise record dump hash and source.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Original Super Famicom hardware with provenanced media

primary.version: Original unlicensed HappySoft release where provenance is known
primary.why: Hong Kong 97 has no normal official storefront route and is an unlicensed underground Super Famicom release. Archive work should document provenance, language, dump/hash, and content warnings instead of treating later videos or sequel news as the artifact.
primary.how_to_play: Use an owned/provenanced Super Famicom copy or documented preservation dump. Record media/source, dump hash, emulator/core or hardware, language, loop/progress state, controller, and explicit content-warning notes.

secondary.why: It is not the 1995 Super Famicom artifact.

entries.remaster_caveats: Record source/provenance, language, content warnings, emulator/core, and avoid merging with Hong Kong 2097.
